name: child-care-cost-by-state
title: Child care cost by state and county: median weekly prices and share of family income
description: County median weekly child care prices for infants, toddlers, preschool and school-age children in centers and family child care homes, with cost as a share of median family income, from the U.S. Department of Labor Women's Bureau National Database of Childcare Prices.

source.name: U.S. Department of Labor, Women's Bureau, National Database of Childcare Prices (NDCP), county-level file 2008-2022

cite_as: BackPR (2026). Child care cost by state and county, from the U.S. Department of Labor Women's Bureau National Database of Childcare Prices (2022 data). https://backpr.com/data/child-care-cost-by-state.json. CC BY 4.0.
sources: U.S. Department of Labor, Women's Bureau, National Database of Childcare Prices (county file 2008-2022; technical report September 2024)
notes: Weekly full-time median prices from state market rate surveys, standardized by the Women's Bureau contractor; prices are in the dollars of the study year and are not inflation-adjusted. Many 2022 values are estimates between survey years or filled in from state data; see the technical report. Cost as a share of income is BackPR's calculation: weekly price x 52 divided by the county's median family income (ACS, same year). A state's typical county is the median of its county medians, not weighted by population.
